data.disagreement_analysis: The qwen model failed to audit hypergrep-arch.patch due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400 BadRequestError), resulting in an inconclusive package verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited the same file and found it to be a standard, safe packaging patch. The disagreement is purely an artifact of a transient API failure, not a difference in security assessment.
coverage_issues: qwen/qwen3-235b-a22b-2507 failed to review hypergrep-arch.patch due to an HTTP 400 API error.
learnings: Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for individual file audits when an LLM API request fails, preventing a single file error from cascading into an inconclusive package verdict.
